integrity: The result contains an elementary complete proof and reproducible independent finite enumeration. Its review is not independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: The full isolated-gap enumeration is proved only for odd multiplicities a>=3 with progression step 2. Finite enumeration is corroborative, not an infinite proof. A full bibliographic exclusion of implicit prior derivations is not available; some related full texts were inaccessible.
title: Isolated gaps of the three-term progression \(\langle a,a+2,a+4\rangle\)
